key.name: project-path
key.description: The absolute path of the Docker Compose project folder to monitor.

key.name: project-name
key.description: Custom name for the monitored Docker Compose project.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: Polling interval in seconds to refresh container status.

key.name: show-container-count
key.description: Toggle visibility of the container count in the top status bar.

key.name: terminal-emulator
key.description: Preferred terminal emulator to use when opening container shells or logs.

key.name: compose-files
key.description: Custom Docker Compose override file path(s).

key.name: compose-file
key.description: Custom Docker Compose override file path.

key.name: active-profiles
key.description: Comma-separated list of active Docker Compose v2 profile names.

key.name: profiles
key.description: Comma-separated list of active Docker Compose v2 profile names.

key.name: custom-host
key.description: Override Docker daemon host endpoint (e.g., unix:///var/run/docker.sock or ssh://user@host).

key.name: custom-cert-path
key.description: Custom path to TLS certificates for Docker daemon connection.

key.name: custom-tls-verify
key.description: Enable TLS verification for custom Docker host connection.

key.name: diagnostic-status
key.description: Last connection validation status for Docker daemon diagnostics.

key.name: diagnostic-error
key.description: Last connection validation error message for Docker daemon diagnostics.

key.name: diagnostic-resolved-host
key.description: Resolved Docker daemon host endpoint used for connection diagnostics.

key.name: diagnostic-resolved-cert-path
key.description: Resolved certificate path used for connection diagnostics.

key.name: diagnostic-resolved-tls-verify
key.description: Resolved TLS verification status used for connection diagnostics.
